IBM Verify billing figures for the CanadaLogin tenant, in the `billing` schema.
Both tables come from CSV reports exported by hand from IBM Verify each month and
uploaded to S3, where the
[monthly billing Lambda](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/upload_source/ibm_verify_monthly_billing/lambda_src/handler.py)
merges them into the tables. `ibm_verify_total_users` holds dated snapshots of
the tenant's total user count, while `ibm_verify_resource_units` holds the
resource units consumed each month by each product group.
